record.paper_title: Open Problems on Configuration Spaces of Tensegrities
record.context_brief: When subgraphs share the same stratification
record.original_question: Determine which subgraphs of the complete graph K_n induce exactly the same stratification of tensegrity configuration space.

evidence.quote: A stratum is by definition a maximal connected component of B_d(G) with equivalent fibers.
In many cases the strata for different graphs coincide. So it is natural to ask the following question. Problem 4 Which subgraphs of Kn define the same stratifications?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n \geq 2$ and let $K_n$ denote the complete graph on the vertex set $\{1,\dots,n\}$. For a subgraph $G \subseteq K_n$ with edge set $E(G)$, a tensegrity configuration is a placement $p=(p_1,\dots,p_n)\in (\mathbb{R}^d)^n$ of the vertices together with an assignment of a real "stress" $w_{ij}$ to every edge $\{i,j\}\in E(G)$ satisfying the equilibrium condition
$$\sum_{j:\{i,j\}\in E(G)} w_{ij}(p_j-p_i)=0 \qquad \text{for every } i=1,\dots,n.$$
Let $W(G,p)\subseteq \mathbb{R}^{E(G)}$ be the linear space of equilibrium stresses on $G$ at the configuration $p$, and let $B_d(G)=\{p\in(\mathbb{R}^d)^n : p \text{ is in general enough position}\}$ be the base of the resulting fiber arrangement, where the fiber over $p$ is $W(G,p)$. Declare two points $p,p'\in B_d(G)$ equivalent if the combinatorial types (in the sense of the signs/zero pattern and linear-dependence structure) of $W(G,p)$ and $W(G,p')$ coincide. A stratum of $G$ is a maximal connected subset of $B_d(G)$ consisting of mutually equivalent configurations; the collection of strata forms the stratification $\mathcal{S}_d(G)$ of $B_d(G)$.

Problem. Characterize all pairs of subgraphs $G_1,G_2\subseteq K_n$ such that $\mathcal{S}_d(G_1)=\mathcal{S}_d(G_2)$, i.e., determine exactly which subgraphs of $K_n$ induce the same stratification of the tensegrity configuration space.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question in the survey of open problems on configuration spaces of tensegrities. A web search does not reveal any later paper resolving the characterization of which subgraphs of $K_n$ induce identical stratifications; related work continues on classifying strata of codimension 1 for small $n$, but the general question remains open.
